title: Reading, Writing, Sharing, and Interacting with the World through Video
task: Survey of video foundation models and world models as joint reading, writing, sharing, and interacting with video
key_results: Comprehensive literature review organizing 150+ papers around four operations; identifies shift from clip-level recognition toward persistent state, controllable dynamics, and interaction-grounded evaluation
comments: This survey provides valuable conceptual unity via world modeling as unifying lens; the four-operation framework (read, write, share, interact) clarifies different research objectives.

task: Interactive user simulation and long-horizon shopping agent evaluation
key_results: UserArena contains 64,729 session trajectories; OPTD achieves strongest simulator fidelity and reproduces production policy effects
comments: Real-world e-commerce benchmark with production A/B validation is a valuable contribution, though trajectory-level distillation's generalization beyond shopping domains is unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Trajectory-level intent provides better supervision than endpoint-only supervision for long-horizon simulation
hypotheses.result: OPTD achieves strongest fidelity; outperforms baselines in offline validation

key_results: 85.0% on MineStudio Bench; 37.4% average success on OpenHA; completes long-horizon crafting tasks
comments: Hierarchical VLA with structured memory and policy-coupled completion detection is well-motivated, though reliance on vision-only may limit applicability to non-visual games.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Policy-coupled task completion detection improves reliability over fixed thresholds
hypotheses.result: Enables sustained long-horizon task execution without manual intervention

title: RSIHub: A Composable Framework for Agent-Evolution Methods
task: Framework for building and comparing agent-evolution methods
key_results: Instantiates 4 methods without core modifications; largest pass@1 gain 13.5 percentage points; method rankings vary across tasks
comments: RSIHub provides valuable infrastructure, but negative result that optimization gains don't transfer to held-out tasks raises questions about method generalization.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Different evolution policies yield varying performance across different task distributions
hypotheses.result: Method rankings vary across MiniSWE, Codex, and Terminal Bench; optimization gains don't transfer

title: RynnUnify: Towards Unified Embodied Brain
task: Unified embodied understanding, visual planning, and robot control

comments: 16B model combining video-language reasoning with world-action extension is ambitious, but success rates suggest substantial room for improvement in robot control.

key_results: 12.9 point improvement on CMM; 8.6 point improvement on AVHBench; 0.67-2.25 point gains on reasoning benchmarks

hypotheses.hypothesis: Representation-level rebalancing is more effective than output-level manipulation for cross-modal hallucinations
hypotheses.result: Consistent improvements across OLLM architectures; generalizes to VideoLLaMA2-AV

title: Every Weight Is a Path of Shared Discrete Decisions
task: Unified weight representation enabling compression method composition
key_results: 9-15% fewer additions than GPTQ at 3-4 bit accuracy; 20-55% reduction on outlier-heavy matrices
comments: TWIG's theoretical elegance (tree structure, discrete decisions) is offset by practical applicability concerns and limited benchmarking scope.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Unified tree-structured weight representation enables better composition of compression methods than separate approaches
hypotheses.result: Outperforms GPTQ on circuit-cost metrics; subsumes existing compression techniques as shallow TWIG instances

title: Dual Exam: Controlled Evaluation of Multimodal Agents and World Models
task: Controlled evaluation of multimodal agents and world models
key_results: GPT-6 Astra: Agent Index 31.3; GPT-Image-2: WM Overall 21.7; coupled pairing achieved zero task successes
comments: Separating agent and world model evaluation is methodologically sound, but zero success on coupled tasks and unclear metric comparability limits immediate utility.

task: Live esports broadcast directing and commentary from multi-camera feed
key_results: Directs better than rule-based/zero-shot directors; commentary wins 29.2% vs 19.4% for baselines against GPT-4o

key_results: 11 of 14 model-reasoning combinations produce conflicting content on most requests; 0.995 task plausibility; Gwet's AC1 ≥0.894
comments: Scalable pipeline and bilingual coverage are strengths, but inability to distinguish between deliberate policy compliance and capability limitations is a significant gap.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Most LLMs produce content conflicting with professional codes without warning
hypotheses.result: 11/14 combinations produce conflicting content on most requests; nearly 3 in 4 warnings accompany conflicting content

title: On-Policy Self-Training: Data-Free Self-Improvement in Large Language Models
task: Self-improvement via on-policy self-training without external supervision
key_results: Consistent improvement across multiple domains; retains non-trained domain capabilities; generalizes to multimodal tasks
comments: Data-free self-improvement framing is valuable, though 'coarse topic descriptions' still constitute some supervision; improvements modest in magnitude.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Models can self-improve by generating and learning from synthetic privileged information without human-curated answers
hypotheses.result: Achieves consistent improvement across text and multimodal benchmarks while retaining non-trained capabilities

title: FLOMSS: Generative Music Source Separation by Flow Matching
task: Music source separation via flow matching
key_results: Competitive performance on MUSDB18-HQ in both objective and subjective evaluations
comments: Flow matching for MSS is well-motivated, but paper lacks quantitative comparisons and specific numerical results compared to baselines.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Generative flow-matching paradigm achieves competitive performance for music source separation
hypotheses.result: Competitive results on MUSDB18-HQ in objective and subjective tests

task: Long-form microdrama script generation with diverse narratives
key_results: 32.1% reduction in causal-pattern repetition; Logic score 82.5 (+8.5 vs baseline) on 60k-word scripts
comments: Backward Narrative Dependency Tree is creative, but evaluation relies partially on custom metrics and limited comparison baselines.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Future-aware memory with evolutionary tree search reduces narrative repetition in long-form generation
hypotheses.result: 32.1% reduction in causal-pattern repetition; 8.5 point improvement in Logic score

task: Auditable AI text detection via interpretable sparse autoencoders
key_results: Recovered human-readable linguistic features; stronger OOD performance than neural and stylometric baselines
comments: SAE-based interpretability for detection is novel and valuable, though scalability to larger models and adversarial robustness unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Interpretable classifiers built on SAE-extracted features outperform opaque neural detectors on OOD text
hypotheses.result: Recovers predictive linguistic tells; achieves stronger OOD performance than neural and stylometric alternatives

title: MultiAgent-OPD: End-to-End Training of Hierarchical Multi-Agent Systems with On-Policy Distillation
task: End-to-end training of hierarchical multi-agent systems
key_results: 38.68% macro avg@4; +4.06pp vs Prompted Critic; +2.61pp vs C-MAS+RL
comments: On-policy distillation with frozen teacher is practical, though 38% success rate suggests fundamental limitations remain.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Combining on-policy distillation with RL enables effective end-to-end training of hierarchical multi-agent systems
hypotheses.result: Outperforms Prompted Critic and cascaded baselines; solves more questions within four attempts

title: MMVistaReason: Toward Open-Data and Post-Training Recipes for Multimodal Reasoning
task: Multimodal reasoning post-training with open data and capacity-aware recipes
key_results: MVR-4B avg 72.8 (matches Qwen3.5-9B with 70% fewer samples); MVR-9B avg 74.4 (exceeds Qwen3.5-35B)
comments: Systematic data construction and specialize-then-integrate training is thorough; scale-dependent capacity interactions are well-studied.

hypotheses.result: 4B matches 9B baseline with 70% fewer samples; 9B surpasses 35B baseline; MOPD provides consistent capability integration

title: DuoLM: Fast and Effective Personalized Recommendation with Language Models
task: Fast and effective personalized recommendation with language models
key_results: 26,400 candidate scores/second on H100; 60x throughput vs teacher with vLLM; comparable recommendation quality
comments: Practical system achieving 60x speedup while maintaining quality is impressive, though end-to-end recommendation metrics not fully detailed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Compact item representations with efficient ranker enable high-throughput personalized recommendation
hypotheses.result: Achieves 26,400 scores/second (60x vs teacher) with comparable quality to full-text teacher model

title: Easy-3Dfy: Object-Level Geometric Composition for Single-Image 3D Scene Construction
task: Single-image 3D scene construction via compositional object generation and layout
key_results: Outperforms SAM-3Dfy on multiple geometric metrics; improves across Scene-Maker and 3D-FUTURE200
comments: Decoupling object generation from layout estimation is sensible, but improvements appear incremental and RPF-based aligner not fully evaluated in isolation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Decoupled object generation and layout estimation enables better geometric composition than end-to-end methods
hypotheses.result: Outperforms SAM-3Dfy on geometric metrics without scene-level supervision

title: LoCA: Enabling Multi-Modality in Geospatial Location Encoders
task: Multi-modal location encoding for geospatial applications
key_results: Wins 68.8% of per-task comparisons across 17 tasks; only model outperforming all others on majority of tasks
comments: Rigorous theoretical analysis (Lipschitz dimension bound) combined with practical multimodal framework is strong; LoCA's generalization to non-EO geospatial data uncertain.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Co-aligned, high-rank multimodal targets enable location encoders to avoid spectral collapse
hypotheses.result: Achieves most task wins across 17 geospatial applications; outperforms all baselines on majority of tasks

title: Echo: Coupled Action and Task Status Signal Denoising for Vision Language Action Models
task: Vision-language-action policy with coupled status signal and action denoising
key_results: Accurately predicts task status (completion/failure); consistently improves policy performance in real-world manipulation
comments: Echo's framing of status signals as action dimensions is elegant; learning without frame-level annotations via trajectory construction is practical.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Coupled action and status signal denoising improves both task status prediction and action generation
hypotheses.result: Accurately predicts task status; consistently improves policy performance on real-world manipulation

title: Generalized CycleGRPO for Fine-Grained Multimodal Understanding and Grounding
task: Unified reinforcement learning for region understanding and localization
key_results: SAMTok gIoU: 68.2% on GroundingSuite (+10.7pp); GRES avg gIoU 78.7% (+7.5pp); Charades tIoU 51.9%
comments: Region-text cycle consistency as self-evaluation principle is novel; DOVE benchmark for temporal distinctiveness is valuable contribution.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cycle consistency between region understanding and localization provides verifiable reward for self-improvement
hypotheses.result: Significant gIoU improvements; temporal distinctiveness on video tasks; framework generalizes across spatial/temporal/spatio-temporal domains

title: RoboJudge: Multimodal Language Models as Judges for Embodied Video Generation
task: Multi-modal language models as judges for embodied video generation
key_results: RoboJudge-9B: Pearson r=0.719 with humans (+0.089 vs Gemini); strongest agreement on Physical Adherence and Instruction Alignment
comments: Systematic evaluation of MLLM agreement on embodied videos is needed; fine-tuned RoboJudge-9B shows promise but 0.719 correlation still indicates substantial disagreement.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fine-tuned MLLM on embodied video annotations achieves higher human agreement than general-purpose models
hypotheses.result: RoboJudge-9B reaches r=0.719; improves 0.089 over Gemini-3.7-Flash; transfers to VideoPhy2 and Physion-Eval

title: DISC: Domain-Integrated Similarity Cost for Time-Series Dataset
task: Learnable aggregation of time-series dataset similarity metrics
key_results: DISC higher alignment than single-metric references on reported split; task-dependent similarity improves transfer prediction
comments: Problem formulation (task-dependent similarity) is well-motivated, but DISC's reliance on calibration data and generalization to new tasks unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Learned metric aggregation better predicts downstream transfer behavior than fixed single metrics
hypotheses.result: DISC higher alignment with downstream errors; integrates complementary metric values more effectively

title: A path-following framework on fiber bundle for variational inequalities
task: Path-following framework for variational inequalities with fiber bundle geometry
key_results: 10^-5 precision on all 6400 instances (dimensions up to 1024); global linear convergence without monotonicity assumptions
comments: Theoretical contribution with fiber bundle formulation and convergence guarantees is solid; practical applicability and comparison to standard methods unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fiber bundle geometric structure enables global convergence for general-sum VI without monotonicity
hypotheses.result: Achieves 10^-5 precision on all instances; global linear convergence for both nonsingular and singular solutions

task: Nash equilibrium computation via fixed-point bundle on product-of-simplex domains
key_results: 10^-5 precision on all 5600 game instances (2-player 128-action to 128-player 2-action); inherits linear convergence guarantees
comments: Extension to product-of-simplex via fiber bundle isomorphism is theoretically elegant; practical game theory applications limited.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Composite fiber bundle structure enables global convergence for Nash equilibria in general-sum games
hypotheses.result: Achieves 10^-5 precision; inherits linear convergence from VI framework via fiber bundle isomorphism

title: HoloBoxing: A Simple Recipe for Humanoid Boxing with 7 Minutes of Single-GPU Training
task: Learning humanoid boxing with minimal task training via pretrained controller reuse
key_results: Seven minutes additional training on single GPU (excluding pretraining); learns boxing via compact planner on frozen controller
comments: Efficient recipe leveraging pretrained controllers is practical, but minimal evaluation scope (simulated boxing) and missing comparison to end-to-end training.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reusing pretrained controller with compact task planner enables efficient learning of new embodied skills
hypotheses.result: Seven-minute training time; imitation initialization enables RL refinement of interaction behavior

title: JockeyBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Horse-Racing Decision-Making
task: Evaluating LLM agents on repeated event forecasting via horse-racing decisions
key_results: Seven revision gains and two declines identified across 28 model-scaffold configs; all configurations showed negative mean profit under capped-Kelly settlement despite some individual profitable runs
comments: The finding that LLM agents consistently lose money despite occasional forecast improvements highlights the gap between prediction quality and actual decision value in sequential forecasting tasks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reusable-program workflow achieves higher profitability than per-race forecasting
hypotheses.result: Reusable-program workflow had higher mean betting profit and lower research fees, but both workflows lost on average

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mean probability bias is consistent across all bets
hypotheses.result: Mean probability bias reverses on selected bets, suggesting differential model behavior

title: PaperFormalizer: Author-in-the-Loop Autoformalization of Research Papers in Lean
task: Automated formalization of mathematical proofs in research papers
key_results: Author-in-the-loop pipeline converts LaTeX papers to Lean-verified code; enables collaborative verification and code reuse across papers
comments: By keeping the author in the decision loop for ambiguous statements, this preserves paper semantics while gaining formal verification—a pragmatic approach to the autoformalization bottleneck.

model_io.model: Claude/Codex coding agent with PaperFormalizer pipeline

hypotheses.hypothesis: Automated transcription can identify gaps in proofs and stated assumptions
hypotheses.result: Pipeline successfully audits statements for faithfulness, ambiguity, and correctness, then proposes repairs to authors

title: Speculative Diffusion is a Tale of Two Tradeoffs
task: Accelerating diffusion language model inference via speculative decoding
key_results: Joint variation of diffusion effort and acceptance leniency extends speed-quality Pareto frontier beyond single-step diffusion drafting
comments: The key insight is that diffusion LLMs enable a new degree of freedom—jointly optimizing draft generation effort and verifier acceptance—not available in traditional speculative decoding.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Speculative diffusion with lenient acceptance criteria can generalize lossless speculative decoding
hypotheses.result: Lossy sampling with more lenient acceptance criteria achieves faster generation at cost of quality, extending the Pareto frontier

title: Does LeWorldModel Preserve Local Action Geometry?
task: Evaluating world model fidelity via local action geometry preservation
key_results: Median angles ~36-42° at small scale; 70% Gram discrepancy reduction at 10x perturbation on Reacher; scale-dependent evaluation necessary
comments: Scale-dependent action sensitivity evaluation is rigorous, but unclear implications for downstream control and limited task coverage.

hypotheses.hypothesis: World models preserve action geometry differently at different perturbation scales
hypotheses.result: Median angle differences ~36-42° at small scale; geometry error decreases with larger perturbations; effect on control remains open

title: SliderEdit++: Improved Slider Trajectories in Instruction-Based Image Editing
task: Continuous slider-based control for instruction-based image editing
key_results: 18.5% relative improvement on SlideBench; 3-20x speedup vs baselines; smooth monotonic traversal with disentanglement
comments: SlideBench benchmark and trajectory-level regularization for smooth control are valuable; evaluation limited to instruction-based editing.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Velocity and semantic-space trajectory regularization with spectral control improves continuous slider controllability
hypotheses.result: 18.5% relative improvement on SlideBench; smooth progression; reduced inter-slider interference

title: Co-adaptive Rule Routing and Constraining for Structured Knowledge Retrieval
task: Structured knowledge retrieval via co-adaptive rule routing without predefined supervision
key_results: Learns routing and retrieval jointly without query-rule pairs; generation-based routing transfers across datasets
comments: Co-adaptation of router and retriever via RL and contrastive learning is well-motivated; limited quantitative benchmarking.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Co-adaptive routing and retrieval without query-rule supervision improves structured knowledge retrieval
hypotheses.result: Routing and retrieval co-adapt via RL and contrastive learning; generation-based routing transfers across domains

title: What Git Does Not Record: Provenance Legibility in Two AI-Assisted Research Repositories
task: Auditing AI tool provenance legibility in research repositories
key_results: 85.6% of prescriptive trace lines visible vs 21.8% of narrative trace; Co-Authored-By trailer covers 66/121 commits (Project A) vs 1/39 commits (Project B proxy)
comments: This empirical audit reveals that repository provenance records are fundamentally ambiguous and unstable—no single channel reliably captures AI involvement, which has important implications for disclosure requirements.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Standing rule files (prescriptive trace) provide more persistent provenance than narrative agent scratchpads
hypotheses.result: Prescriptive trace has far higher line visibility (85.6% vs 21.8%) but both show substantial revision-level gaps in recording AI involvement

hypotheses.hypothesis: Standard metadata trailers reliably indicate AI involvement
hypotheses.result: Co-Authored-By trailer has low sensitivity; only 2.6% of agent-edited commits in Project B carry it, contradicting metadata-only audit approaches

hypotheses.hypothesis: Stage-adaptive view coordination improves robustness and stage adaptability
hypotheses.result: Dynamic routing outperforms persistent wrist-view reliance, particularly during manipulation stages requiring global-local coordination

title: Light-regulated biomaterial interfaces enable flexible neural bioelectronics with stable adhesion and on-demand detachment for chronic electrophysiology
task: Achieving stable chronic neural recording with on-demand reversible adhesion
key_results: Photo-programmable bPDMS@Fe electrode achieves stable epidermal ECG recording and stable local field potential recording with seizure mapping in freely moving mice; UV-induced adhesion weakening enables controlled device retrieval
comments: Dynamic Fe3+-carboxylate coordination provides an elegant solution to the chronic implant paradox—balancing mechanical stability against tissue damage during removal.

hypotheses.result: Robust adhesion to diverse substrates with UV-controllable weakening confirmed

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dynamic adhesive interface supports chronic stable recording in vivo

title: Three-dimensional cell morphology is mediated by curvature sensing and interfacial stress
task: Determining physical principles governing 3D cell morphology and curvature sensing
key_results: Interfacial stress ratio (contractile stress/adhesion stress) predicts morphological modes; ratio >1 triggers irreversible shift from complete adhesion to partial interior detachment
comments: Universal biophysical framework across multiple cell types suggests stress-based morphology control is a fundamental organizing principle in tissue development and wound healing.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Interfacial stress ratio determines morphological state transitions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across single cells, pharmacological perturbations, and multicellular layers

hypotheses.hypothesis: Morphological shift is irreversible and energy-driven
hypotheses.result: Transition proceeds toward lower-energy state when stress ratio exceeds unity

title: Continuous mass photometry by single-molecule trapping
task: Mass-resolved tracking of individual biomolecules on lipid bilayers
key_results: Hour-long observation with sub-kilodalton mass precision and millisecond temporal resolution; quantitative time-resolved measurements of biomolecular complexes and interactions
comments: Continuous mass photometry extends single-molecule observation timescales by orders of magnitude compared to conventional approaches, enabling direct kinetic study of assembly processes.

title: Pericyte Snai1 ablation prevents pathological angiogenesis in retinopathy via extracellular matrix remodelling-mediated inhibition of endothelial cell activation
task: Determine Snai1-mediated ECM remodeling in pericytes driving pathological retinal angiogenesis
key_results: Pericyte Snai1 upregulates Col4a1, Lox, and other ECM genes; creates pro-angiogenic niche; BAPN (Lox inhibitor) phenocopies Snai1 deletion; hypoxic ECs stabilize Snai1 via ANGPT2/TGFβ1

title: HIPK2-and IKKβ-dependent phosphorylation stabilizes TAp63α during the oocyte DNA damage response
task: Elucidate TAp63α stability regulation during oocyte DNA damage response

title: Histone lactylation mediates the regulation of dental follicle cells' senescence driven by RUNX2 during the process of tooth eruption
task: Determine histone lactylation-mediated RUNX2 control of dental follicle senescence in tooth eruption
key_results: RUNX2 mutation/knockdown increases HDAC3 expression, reducing H3K18la and PLAU transcription; NMN (NAD+ booster) delays eruption; senescent cell accumulation drives normal eruption

title: p38α acts as a molecular switch to differentially regulate the Flt3 and CD115 pathways in dendritic cell development
task: Elucidate p38α role as molecular switch balancing Flt3L and M-CSF signaling in DC development

title: Transient efferocytosis-induced activation of IKKβ reprograms macrophages to promote tissue resolution in mice
task: Identify IKKβ-NFκB/p38-Myc-TET2-PD-L1 axis downstream of MerTK in efferocytosis-mediated resolution

title: Midkine as a context-dependent molecular rheostat in tissue regeneration and aging
task: Review MDK's context-dependent roles in tissue regeneration and aging
key_results: MDK is dynamically regulated post-injury across cardiovascular, neural, musculoskeletal, liver, and kidney tissues; dysregulation occurs with aging and links to fibrosis, immune aging, and tumors
comments: A comprehensive review synthesizing MDK biology, but lacks quantitative experimental validation of proposed therapeutic approaches.

title: Microglial NUS1 deficiency drives dopaminergic neurodegeneration through intercellular iron dysregulation in Parkinson’s disease models
